channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2008-4128 — Cisco IOS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Cisco IOS 12.4 contains multiple cross-site forgery vulnerabilities that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via (1) a certain "show privilege" command to the /level/15/exec/- URI, and (2) a certain "alias exec" command to the /level/15/exec/-/configure/http URI.

item.title: CVE-2015-3246 — Red Hat Libuser
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-21962 — Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.

item.title: CVE-2022-0028 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 58. A Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS URL filtering policy misconfiguration could allow a network-based attacker to conduct reflected and amplified TCP denial-of-service (RDoS) attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-76504 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2023-20273 — Cisco Cisco IOS XE Web UI
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Cisco IOS XE contains a command injection vulnerability in the web user interface. When chained with CVE-2023-20198, the attacker can leverage the new local user to elevate privilege to root and write the implant to the file system. Cisco identified CVE-2023-20273 as the vulnerability exploited to deploy the implant. CVE-2021-1435, previously associated with the exploitation events, is no longer believed to be related to this activity.

item.title: CVE-2016-9079 — Mozilla Firefox, Firefox ESR, and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Mozilla Firefox, Firefox ESR, and Thunderbird contain a use-after-free vulnerability in SVG Animation, targeting Firefox and Tor browser users on Windows.

item.title: CVE-2023-28432 — MinIO MinIO
item.description: Threat Signal 72. MinIO contains a vulnerability in a cluster deployment where MinIO returns all environment variables, which allows for information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2013-3163 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial of service via a crafted website.

item.title: CVE-2018-19323 — GIGABYTE Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2022-37969 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2018-7445 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 72. In MikroTik RouterOS, a stack-based buffer overflow occurs when processing NetBIOS session request messages. Remote attackers with access to the service can exploit this vulnerability and gain code execution on the system.

item.title: CVE-2013-1331 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted PNG data in an Office document.

item.title: CVE-2012-4969 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2009-4324 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Acrobat and Reader allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted PDF file.

item.title: CVE-2015-4495 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Moxilla Firefox allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy to read arbitrary files or gain privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-8651 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Integer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2012-1710 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Unspecified vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Forms Recognition component in Oracle Fusion Middleware allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors related to Designer.

item.title: CVE-2021-21551 — Dell dbutil Driver
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Dell dbutil driver contains an insufficient access control vulnerability which may lead to escalation of privileges, denial-of-service (DoS), or information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2017-0037 — Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer have a type confusion vulnerability in mshtml.dll, which allows remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-1690 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird do not properly handle onreadystatechange events in conjunction with page reloading, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) or possibly execute malicious code via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2019-2616 — Oracle BI Publisher (Formerly XML Publisher)
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Oracle BI Publisher, formerly XML Publisher, contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for various unauthorized actions. Open-source reporting attributes this vulnerability to allowing for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2015-3035 — TP-Link Multiple Archer Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Directory traversal vulnerability in multiple TP-Link Archer devices allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the PATH_INFO to login/.

item.title: CVE-2019-1405 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows UPnP service improperly allows COM object creation.

item.title: CVE-2017-6736 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

item.title: CVE-2017-11826 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office software when the software fails to properly handle objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could run arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2017-0261 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-4114 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A vulnerability exists in Windows Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) that could allow remote code execution if a user opens a file that contains a specially crafted OLE object.

item.title: CVE-2012-1856 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The TabStrip ActiveX control in the Common Controls in MSCOMCTL.OCX in Microsoft Office allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted (1) document or (2) web page that triggers system-state corruption.

item.title: CVE-2017-0262 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office.

item.title: CVE-2021-25296 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2021-22991 — F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management Microkernel
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The Traffic Management Microkernel of BIG-IP ASM Risk Engine has a buffer overflow vulnerability, leading to a bypassing of URL-based access controls.

item.title: CVE-2021-27103 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Accellion FTA contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to wmProgressstat.html.

item.title: CVE-2018-4939 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-11634 — Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Citrix Workspace Application and Receiver for Windows contains remote code execution vulnerability resulting from local drive access preferences not being enforced into the clients' local drives.

item.title: CVE-2020-15999 — Google Chrome FreeType
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Google Chrome uses FreeType, an open-source software library to render fonts, which contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the function Load_SBit_Png when processing PNG images embedded into fonts. This vulnerability is part of an exploit chain with CVE-2020-17087 on Windows and CVE-2020-16010 on Android.

item.title: CVE-2021-21220 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-0674 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to the way the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory. Successful exploitation could allow remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2020-8243 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability in the admin web interface that could allow an authenticated attacker to upload a custom template to perform code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-93616 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

item.title: CVE-2026-19490 — Citrix NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-45659 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-34910 — Ubiquiti UniFi OS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

item.title: CVE-2026-48027 — Nx Nx Console
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Nx Console contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allowed a malicious version of Nx Console to be published. The compromised extension fetched an obfuscated payload that could harvested credentials from multiple sources on disk and in memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-45321 — TanStack TanStack
item.description: Threat Signal 71. TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.

item.title: CVE-2026-2441 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Google Chromium CSS contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2019-9621 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability via the ProxyServlet component.

item.title: CVE-2025-42999 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 71. SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a privileged attacker to compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the host system by deserializing untrusted or malicious content.

item.title: CVE-2025-30066 — tj-actions changed-files GitHub Action
item.description: Threat Signal 71. tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to discover secrets by reading Github Actions Workflow Logs. These secrets may include, but are not limited to, valid AWS access keys, GitHub personal access tokens (PATs), npm tokens, and private RSA keys.

item.title: CVE-2020-29574 — Sophos CyberoamOS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. CyberoamOS (CROS) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the WebAdmin that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements remotely.
